description: Microsoft Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant experience. Available capabilities vary across consumer, Windows and Microsoft 365 experiences and account plans.
usage: Open the Copilot experience available to your account, describe the task and provide context. For Microsoft 365 workflows, confirm which apps and license features are enabled in your organization.

examples.title: Create a project plan
examples.content: Create a project plan for a responsive website redesign. Include phases, tasks, dependencies, risks and measurable outcomes.

examples.title: Meeting summary template
examples.content: Create a meeting summary template with decisions, action items, owners and due dates.

examples.title: Explain a concept
examples.content: Explain the difference between CSS Flexbox and CSS Grid with practical layout examples and a decision guide.

questions.question: What is Microsoft Copilot?
questions.answer: Microsoft Copilot is Microsoft's family of AI assistant experiences that help users with information, content creation and productivity.

questions.question: Where can I access Copilot?
questions.answer: Availability depends on the experience and account. The consumer entry point is copilot.microsoft.com.

questions.question: Is every Copilot feature free?
questions.answer: No. Features, usage limits and integrations vary by product, subscription, region and organization settings.

questions.question: Can Copilot help write content?
questions.answer: Yes. It can draft, rewrite, summarize and organize content based on the instructions and context provided.

questions.question: What is Microsoft 365 Copilot?
questions.answer: It is a Copilot offering integrated with supported Microsoft 365 apps and organizational data, subject to licensing and configuration.

questions.question: Is consumer Copilot the same as Microsoft 365 Copilot?
questions.answer: No. They are related experiences but differ in integrations, features, licensing and data context.

questions.question: Can Copilot help with presentations?
questions.answer: Supported Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences can assist with presentation creation and editing, depending on the plan and app.

questions.question: Can Copilot help with Excel?
questions.answer: Some Microsoft 365 Copilot experiences can help analyze data and work with formulas, subject to eligibility and product support.

questions.question: Can Copilot generate code?
questions.answer: It can assist with code explanations and generation. Microsoft also offers GitHub Copilot, a separate coding-focused product.

questions.question: What is GitHub Copilot?
questions.answer: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant integrated into supported development environments and GitHub workflows.

questions.question: How do I write a good Copilot prompt?
questions.answer: Describe the task, context, audience, constraints and the format you want.

questions.question: Can Copilot summarize a meeting?
questions.answer: Supported Microsoft 365 experiences can summarize meetings when the required services, permissions and licensing are enabled.

questions.question: Why do Copilot features differ between accounts?
questions.answer: Feature availability can depend on subscription, region, app version, admin settings and rollout status.

questions.question: Should I enter confidential work data?
questions.answer: Follow your organization's approved tools, data policies and account protections before sharing confidential information.

questions.question: Can Copilot explain a spreadsheet formula?
questions.answer: You can ask it to explain a formula, but verify the explanation against the actual workbook and calculations.

questions.question: What is an AI-generated draft?
questions.answer: It is a first version created by AI that should be reviewed and edited before being shared.

questions.question: How can Copilot improve productivity?
questions.answer: It can reduce time spent on drafting, summarizing, planning and finding information in supported workflows.

questions.question: Does Copilot always provide correct answers?
questions.answer: No. AI output can be inaccurate or incomplete and should be checked.

questions.question: What is the difference between Copilot and a search engine?
questions.answer: Copilot generates conversational assistance, while a search engine primarily helps find and rank web pages.

questions.question: How should I evaluate Copilot's output?
questions.answer: Check accuracy, completeness, source quality, privacy implications and whether the result meets your task requirements.
